posts.title_en: Package value roundup: strongly recommended tab
posts.summary_en: The gallery manager's package value series. Every package is priced against the plain Crystal pack (100%), converting contents at fixed rates (1 Crystal = 4 KRW, 1 Rune Crystal = 4.6 KRW, 1 Lucky Dough = 13.53 KRW, 1 Stellar Point = 8.67 KRW, 1 Chocosteel = 50 Crystals, 1 Syrup Metal = 125 Crystals, a random SSR Cookie = 16,600 Crystals, a chosen SSR Cookie = 33,340, each Daily Dungeon key = 750 Crystals). The author warns the conversion rates are the publisher's own and differ from what the goods are really worth. Advice: a light spender buys Ad Removal, the Crumble Pass and the 55,000 KRW permanent (5.5) membership; a whale buys Chocosteel and Syrup Metal.

datapoints.note: The percentages attach to screenshots, not named in text.

advice.text: Light spender: Ad Removal, Crumble Pass, 5.5 permanent membership. Whale: Chocosteel and Syrup Metal.

quotes.en: For a light spender: Ad Removal, Crumble Pass, the 5.5 permanent pack

1 Stellar Point = 8.67 KRW

Filling slots with Unique gear raised power sharply.

quotes.en: Stellar seems like the sweetest deal
Power shot up once I filled up on Unique gear

posts.title_en: Is power mostly gear in the end?

posts.summary_en: A player with the lab fully researched to step 43 asks what else raises power. Replies: Fame is low (someone at the same Resolve had Fame in the 90s; Arena wins are the only source, so hit only beatable opponents); open Stellar 7–8; expected Stellar Point cost of an 8-point octagon about 1,900 versus 7,900 for a 10-point decagon; 8 stars' expected area is 91%.

advice.text: Fame only comes from Arena wins; attack beatable opponents to earn it.

quotes.en: Octagon expected cost 1,900, decagon 7,900
8 stars' expected area is 91%

advice.text: Grind coin auto-hunt rewards into Resolve; with plates it makes the power gap.
Pull cookies to open constellations 6 and 8.

posts.title_en: Should F2P just get Stellar Link above 90?
posts.summary_en: F2P route: 39% with 3 points open, a square at 4, a regular hexagon at 6, then 95% once 10 are open; or the 91% octagon, spending leftovers on a decagon at constellations 7–8.

advice.text: 3 open: 39%; 4: square; 6: hexagon; 10: 95%. F2P: octagon 91%, decagon at 7–8 with leftovers.

quotes.en: F2P: just the 91% octagon; decagon at Stellar 7–8 if points are left

posts.title_en: Item power is dynamic
posts.summary_en: An item's power value depends on the current stats: once a resistance target is met, the same item's power drops (69.6M → 65M); accuracy above about 1,000 adds little power. High-power items therefore tend to fill the stats you are short of.
